perks.name: Slideshot
perks.description: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability.

perks.name: Lead from Gold
perks.description: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.

perks.name: Repulsor Brace
perks.description: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.

perks.name: Loose Change
perks.description: Applying an elemental debuff to a target increases this weapon's reload speed, aim assist, and movement while aiming down sights for a short duration.

perks.name: Well-Rounded
perks.description:
Throwing a grenade or hitting a target with a charged melee grants a stacking bonus to weapon stability, handling, and range.

Using a Super grants maximum stacks.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.description: Faster time to aim down sights.

perks.name: One-Two Punch
perks.description: Hitting an enemy with every pellet in a shot increases melee damage for a short duration.

perks.name: Killing Wind
perks.description: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for a short duration.

perks.name: Barrel Constrictor
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon reduce its projectile spread for a short duration.

perks.name: Deconstruct
perks.description:
Dealing sustained damage grants bonus damage against vehicles and constructs and refills ammo from reserves. Damage with Primary ammo or against constructs provides additional progress.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.description: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

flavor: "It's what gets left out, what gets reemphasized that you have to pay attention to." —Esila, daughter of Sila
